# INFELIX-CLASS OUTLAW SHUTTLE
[color=#a4885c]Ship Size:[/color] Small
[color=#a4885c]Recommended Crew:[/color] 1-2
[color=#a4885c]Power Gen Type:[/color] Solar + Plasma
# Shuttle Brief
A small solar-powered outlaw vessel.
# Ship Functions
The Infelix ditches the expensive mining gear, replacing them with cargo racks ideal for plunder or smuggling. The salvage bay doors now hide a deadly cannon.
Note that the solar array is not guaranteed to produce sufficient power for continuous thruster operation. Use the thruster power toggle button on the bridge to disable thrusters when docked if attempting to operate without consuming biofuel.
# Button Configuration
The ship console has buttons mapped:
[bullet/] [bold]1:[/bold] Turn thrusters+gyro on.
[bullet/] [bold]2:[/bold] Turn thrusters+gyro off.
[bullet/] [bold]3:[/bold] Toggle bridge windows.
[bullet/] [bold]4:[/bold] Docking port bolt toggle.
[bullet/] [bold]5:[/bold] Open gun port doors.
[bullet/] [bold]6:[/bold] Close gun port doors.
[bullet/] [bold]7:[/bold] Fire cannon (with door safety check).
[bullet/] [bold]8:[/bold] Fire cannon (override door safety check).
# Upgrade Requirements
The Infelix has 8 thrusters, requiring a total of 32 capacitors.
Its generator and gyro together require 2 capacitors and 2 manipulators.
Its SMES requires 1 capacitor and 4 power cells (or 2 capacitors and 8 power cells for advanced SMES).
Its autolathe requires 1 manipulator and 3 matter bins.
It has 25 solar panels, requiring a total of 50 glass.
Overall, this means its full upgrade (including advanced SMES) requires: [bold]36[/bold] capacitors, [bold]3[/bold] manipulators, [bold]3[/bold] matter bins, [bold]8[/bold] power cells, and [bold]50[/bold] glass.
